title: Chris Brown Owns 58 Burger Kings, Says Wack 100
htmlContent:
On Saturday morning, wack 100 was on Clubhouse in the EBAN FILMS room, discussing various topics, including Chris Brown. Wack was talking about a lot of entertainers that own different types of businesses, but they haven't broadcast it to the world.

"S*** Chris Brown owns about 58 Burger Kings," said Wack 100.

"You be trying to count an N****'s pockets on what you see." N*** got real investments."

He added, "Rap money is not here you, don't get me wrong some of these artists can live forever off their catalog and always go tour, but they get tired of touring and dealing with s***. The risk of women and all of this crazy s***, so the rap game is just there for you to lay down a foundation for you to spin off and really do something else. It's a few people that would have been dead-broke, that's why Birdman you have to give him his flowers because he is still winning off rap money; if you look at a n*** like J- Prince who was right there with him at that time, right? He ain't doing rap money. He got motherf**** cattle."

Speaking of Chris Brown, it is being reported that he welcomed his third child with Diamond Brown.

"The princess is here! Lovely Symphani Brown," she wrote in her caption. "My sweet babygirl, it's been a whole day you've been in the world and have already shown me the true meaning of life. I promise to love and protect you always. Forever yours, mommy.."

Brown has not yet commented on the news, according to radaronline.com.
